entries.title: II Timothy 4:1
segments: ¶I give you orders, before God and Christ Jesus, who will be the judge of the living and the dead, and by his revelation and his kingdom;

entries.title: II Timothy 4:2
segments: Be preaching the word at all times, in every place; make protests, say sharp words, give comfort, with long waiting and teaching;

entries.title: II Timothy 4:3
segments: For the time will come when they will not take the true teaching; but, moved by their desires, they will get for themselves a great number of teachers for the pleasure of hearing them;

entries.title: II Timothy 4:4
segments: And shutting their ears to what is true, will be turned away to belief in foolish stories.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:5
segments: But be self-controlled in all things, do without comfort, go on preaching the good news, completing the work which has been given you to do.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:6
segments: For I am even now being offered, and my end is near.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:7
segments: I have made a good fight, I have come to the end of my journey, I have kept the faith:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:8
segments: From now on, the crown of righteousness is made ready for me, which the Lord, the upright judge, Will give to me at that day: and not only to me, but to all those who have had love for his revelation.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:9
segments: ¶Do your best to come to me before long:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:10
segments: For Demas has gone away from me, for love of this present life, and has gone to Thessalonica: Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:11
segments: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and take him with you; for he is of use to me in the work.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:12
segments: Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:13
segments: The coat which I did not take from Troas and which is with Carpus, get when you come, and the books, specially the papers.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:14
segments: Alexander the copper-worker did me much wrong: the Lord will give him the reward of his works:

entries.title: II Timothy 4:15
segments: But be on the watch for him, for he was violent in his attacks on our teaching.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:16
segments: ¶At my first meeting with my judges, no one took my part, but all went away from me. May it not be put to their account.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:17
segments: But the Lord was by my side and gave me strength; so that through me the news might be given out in full measure, and all the Gentiles might give ear: and I was taken out of the mouth of the lion.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:18
segments: The Lord will keep me safe from every evil work and will give me salvation in his kingdom in heaven: to whom be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:19
segments: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila and those of the house of Onesiphorus.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:20
segments: Erastus was stopping at Corinth; but Trophimus, when I last saw him was at Miletus, ill.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:21
segments: Do your best to come before the winter. Eubulus sends you his love, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.

entries.title: II Timothy 4:22
segments: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
